description: Calculate dimensional and billable kg from caller-supplied centimetres, actual kg, divisor and optional rounding step. No carrier price lookup. Costs $0.001 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].

actualKg.description: Actual weight in kg, positive, max 10000

divisor.description: Caller-supplied dimensional divisor in cm^3/kg, positive, max 100000

roundingStepKg.description: Optional positive ceiling step in kg; omitted means no carrier rounding

name: carton_weight
title: Johto Data Carton Dimensional Billable Weight Calculator
